component.name: Notterizmus
component.summary: Outline editor for book chapter notes

description.p: Notterizmus is an outline editor for taking notes on book chapters. It numbers items automatically (Ⅰ, Ⅰ.1, Ⅰ.1.a) and draws tree lines between them, and it copies the result as formatted text that pastes cleanly into TopCoding.

ul.li: Automatic numbering with Unicode Roman numerals and tree connectors
Bullets for notes, pros and cons; bold, italic and tables
Paste that recognises outline structure and renumbers it
Undo and redo for text and structure, selection scopes and multiple cursors
Spell checking in English and Bulgarian, chosen per chapter
One autosaved file per book chapter
